answer: Sybil resistance comes from binding each identity to a Wesolowski VDF whose proof requires continuous, sequential modular squarings: every step depends on the preceding result, so cloning identities multiplies elapsed work rather than enabling a shortcut. GPUs may add throughput, but cannot collapse the per-identity critical path, imposing a physical time bottleneck. A gale of forged nodes therefore cannot outrun the delta interval, while ferrous hardware gains remain bounded.
